clue.text: Convey fury with Spain to ancient capital

parts.note: to cart something is to carry or convey it
a fury is a fierce, violent woman, a hag or harridan
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: An instruction to haul one's rage, plus Spain, off to some old seat of power.
explanation.definitionFit: The Phoenician city in North Africa was the capital of a great trading empire before Rome razed it.

clue.text: Senior officer came across special space travellers

parts.note: CO is a commanding officer
met means came across, encountered

explanation.surface: A commanding officer bumped into some unusual astronauts.
explanation.definitionFit: These icy bodies journey through the solar system in long orbits, so they travel through space.

clue.text: Conservationists separate material for hire

indicators.note: the word for material is split apart by the letters going in

parts.note: material in the sense of physical, real
NT is the National Trust, a British heritage conservation charity

explanation.surface: Environmentalists sort out cloth to let.
explanation.definitionFit: A rental car or property is one available to hire.

clue.text: Retire to buffet the YHA organised

parts.note: to buffet is to strike, to hit

indicators.note: the letters are organised into a new order

explanation.surface: A youth hostel arranges a buffet before bedtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' rearranges YHA into HAY. The YHA is the Youth Hostels Association.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to go to bed, as retiring for the night does.

clue.text: Follow the directors or come to grief

parts.note: to go by something is to follow it, as a rule
a company's directors make up the board

explanation.surface: Either obey the board or come a cropper.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom, from things lost over a ship's side, means to be abandoned or ruined.

clue.text: Man gets the Castilian into place of worship

parts.note: a chap is a man
el is the Spanish (Castilian) word for 'the'

explanation.surface: A man ushers a Spaniard into a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A small church or a room set aside for services is a place where people worship.

clue.text: Hothead has weaponry that causes injury

parts.note: the head of hot is its first letter
arms are weapons

explanation.surface: A hot-tempered person owns guns that wound people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hothead' looks like a rash person but splits as the head of 'hot'.
explanation.definitionFit: To harm someone is to hurt or damage them.

clue.text: The way name's brought up is contemptible

parts.note: a path is a way

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to cite is to name, mention

explanation.surface: Criticism of how someone's name gets raised.
explanation.definitionFit: Pathetic means feeble and pitiful, worthy of scorn.

clue.text: Speech of film director getting fashionable over time

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sits over, above, the next

parts.note: Fritz Lang directed Metropolis
U means upper-class, socially acceptable
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A filmmaker's speech becomes trendier over the years.
explanation.definitionFit: Language is spoken communication, the faculty of speech.

clue.text: Last part of contingent departed in frenzy for region of North America

indicators.note: the pieces are placed in the middle of the word for frenzy

parts.note: mania is a frenzy

indicators.note: asks for only the final letter of contingent

parts.note: OB, short for Latin obiit 'he died', means departed

explanation.surface: The rear of a troop leaves in a panic, bound for somewhere in America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'departed' gives OB, the abbreviation of Latin obiit, 'died', seen in obituary notices.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a prairie province of central Canada, so a region of the continent.

clue.text: French person in British school

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: A Frenchman enrolled at a school in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Brittany, in north-west France, is a French national.

clue.text: Lose funds but shift suspicion

indicators.note: the letters shift position into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Losing money but moving it raises suspicion.
explanation.definitionFit: Doubt about whether someone is honest is suspicion.

clue.text: Tory leader spots scum

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of Tory

parts.note: a rash is an outbreak of spots on the skin

explanation.surface: The head of the Conservatives sees some lowlifes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spots' looks like a verb, 'sees', but it is the noun: a rash.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are dismissive words for people regarded as worthless, the lowest dregs.

clue.text: Initially, the painter depicts bride's clothing

indicators.note: means take just the opening letter of the

parts.note: Henri Rousseau was the French naive painter

explanation.surface: An artist paints the bride's outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: A trousseau is the collection of clothes and linen a bride assembles for her marriage.

clue.text: List transport in faction that facilitates revolution

indicators.note: the two pieces sit in the middle of the word for faction

parts.note: a wing is a faction of a party
a ship that lists heels over
to bear is to carry or transport

explanation.surface: A political faction keeps a list of transport, apparently in aid of revolution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolution' reads as political uprising, chiming with 'faction', but means turning.
explanation.definitionFit: This engineering part lets a wheel spin freely on its axle, so it makes rotation possible.

clue.text: Confirm item of furniture can be turned aside

parts.note: to aver is to affirm or confirm
a table is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: Checking that a piece of furniture can be swivelled away.
explanation.definitionFit: To avert is to deflect or ward off, so something avertable can be diverted.

clue.text: Firm invested in drink? That's deliberate!

indicators.note: one piece is put inside the other, invested in it

parts.note: mead is a drink made from honey
sure means firm, steady

explanation.surface: A company puts money into alcohol, on purpose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Firm' reads as a company but is the adjective, sure.
explanation.definitionFit: A measured response is slow and careful, which is to say deliberate.

clue.text: Fail to get back in time, becoming sad

indicators.note: the turned piece goes inside the word for time

parts.note: a date is a point in time

indicators.note: the word for fail to get is turned back

parts.note: to lose is to fail to get or win

explanation.surface: Missing the return deadline leaves one unhappy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns LOSE into ESOL, set 'in' DATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Desolate means miserable and forlorn, deeply unhappy.

clue.text: Always having yen to appease, entertaining Oscar occasionally

parts.note: ever means always
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese currency yen

indicators.note: the word for appease plays host to the letter, holding it inside

parts.note: to soften someone is to appease them
Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A people-pleaser who keeps the Academy Award-winner sweet now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means from time to time, at intervals, which is what occasionally says.

clue.text: Take exception to article

definitions.meaning: to protest against or disapprove of

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to protest; as a noun it is a thing, an article.

clue.text: Another messenger reveals himself

indicators.note: the god lies concealed in the words and shows himself across them

explanation.surface: A further courier comes forward to identify himself.
explanation.walkthrough: The god is in 'anotHER MESsenger'; and he is a messenger himself, so the whole clue defines him.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the winged-sandalled god carries messages for Zeus and the Olympians.

clue.text: Villain gives poor Don ulcers

indicators.note: the letters are in a poor state, damaged and so jumbled

explanation.surface: A wicked man inflicts ulcers on poor Don.
explanation.definitionFit: A scoundrel is a dishonest rogue, a synonym for a villain.

clue.text: Retreats agreed in numbers

indicators.note: the word for agreed is placed in the abbreviation for numbers

parts.note: OK means agreed

explanation.surface: Withdrawals were agreed in large numbers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retreats' reads as a verb but is a plural noun: hideaways.
explanation.definitionFit: A nook is a secluded corner, a quiet place to retreat to.

clue.text: Rumour about second-class furniture

indicators.note: the word for rumour goes around, about, the letter

parts.note: a tale is a piece of gossip or rumour
B is the grade below A, second-class

explanation.surface: Gossip that some furniture is shoddy.
explanation.definitionFit: A table is a standard piece of furniture.

clue.text: Think about an issue

parts.note: re means about, concerning
an is the article A
a son is issue, offspring

explanation.surface: Mull over a problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'issue' means a matter here on the surface, but offspring in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To reason is to use the mind logically, to think things through.

clue.text: Bear swims in channel for fish

indicators.note: the scrambled letters are placed in the word for channel

parts.note: a seam is a groove or channel, as in a mine seam

indicators.note: letters that swim move about, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bear paddles across a waterway after a fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swims' gives ABRE, and 'in' sets it within the channel word.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a marine food fish of the porgy family.

clue.text: Stylish, clean and young

parts.note: to dress fish or game is to clean and gut it

explanation.surface: A description of someone smart, tidy and youthful.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressy clothes are smart and elegant, the opposite of casual.

clue.text: Wally stores prime, oxygen-resistant material

indicators.note: the word for wally keeps the pieces stored inside it

parts.note: a wally (British slang) is a fool, an ass
prime means best
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A fool keeps top-quality supplies of something that won't burn.
explanation.definitionFit: This fibrous mineral was used for fireproofing because it withstands heat.
